variant_definition.exact: Use frozen public nominal complex path coefficients.
variant_definition.neutral: Set every public initial complex mean to 0+0j.
variant_definition.amplitude_minus_10pct: Multiply each public nominal coefficient by 0.9.
variant_definition.amplitude_plus_10pct: Multiply each public nominal coefficient by 1.1.
variant_definition.phase_minus_15deg: Rotate each public nominal coefficient by -15 degrees.
variant_definition.phase_plus_15deg: Rotate each public nominal coefficient by +15 degrees.

held_constant: same saved received observation within each frame across all six variants
same receiver configuration except prior means
same amplitude, noise variance, trellis, metric, decoder and traceback depth
no new transmitter, channel or noise draws

analysis.inferential_status: exploratory prior sensitivity; not confirmatory energy-gain evidence

compute_budget.resume_policy: immutable per-variant outputs; skip only when stored hashes and provenance verify
